chapter: Spirits of Rhythm and the road in the 1930s
title: Hawaiian guitarists and Roy Smeck
summary: Bunn never played in the big white shows with Hawaiian guitarists like Roy Smeck; old recordings bring back memories.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Did you ever play with any of the Hawaiian guitarists, or in those revues?
No, I mean in the '30s they had a few over, like with shows, like Ukulele Ike or --
Roy Smeck used to play some Hawaiian too, didn't he?
He probably did. I don't even know. I've heard of him, but --
Yeah. You never played in any of the bigger shows.
I guess those were mostly white shows with Roy Smeck.
Uh-huh. But you're going back now, when you're going back --
I'm so glad that you've got it.
You've got my brain going around like this.
Well, when you hear those old recordings, you know, it brings it back.
It brings a lot of memories.
